package: FHP-owned conformance vector set (docs/DEVELOPMENT-TREE.md Q4, FAIR-bioHeaders/FHP-Specification#2): every pinned fhp-fasta vector of the shared v0.5.0 line, the FHP-owned fhp-fasta-author-bad-name-type addition, and the shared FASTA-container vectors that exercise the docs/FORMAT.md rules on the FASTA header reader. The complete family manifest runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml.
checksumDefinition: base64(SHA-512/256) over the (decompressed) file bytes except the root-level checksum line and its terminator (FASTA and FHP FASTA vectors; the extracted-metadata formats of the family manifest carry the checksum as an ordinary metadata value)

R1.summary: Checksum rule 1: hash the exact file bytes without normalization; for gzip/BGZF input, the decompressed bytes. A line ends at LF, CRLF or a CR not followed by LF.

R2.summary: Checksum rule 2: exactly one root-level checksum line with an unquoted key; spaces only to match root indentation and before the colon; nested checksum properties stay covered.

R3.summary: Checksum rule 3: exclude that entire line and its terminator; hash every other byte, so changing covered bytes invalidates the checksum.

R4.summary: Checksum rule 4: SHA-512/256 digest in standard padded base64, no prefix; the encoding is canonical (the unused bits are zero) and checksums compare as exact strings.

R5.summary: Header parsing: the checksum line holds only the 44-character value, plain or quoted, with optional spaces or tabs; comments, tags, other text, block scalars and continuation lines are invalid.

R6.summary: Header parsing: FHR header lines are UTF-8 without U+0085, U+2028 or U+2029; bytes outside header lines are not decoded.

R7.summary: Header parsing: a FASTA/GFA file must not begin with a UTF-8 byte order mark.

R8.summary: Header parsing: no duplicate mapping keys, YAML anchors, aliases or merge keys.

R9.summary: Header parsing: in microdata the first of repeated attributes applies; itemtype and itemprop are space-separated token lists.
R9.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

R10.summary: Header parsing: FHR lines form the leading header block; a later FHR line, including one from a concatenated file, is invalid.

R11.summary: Header writing (FASTA): header lines should not contain a raw '>' or '@'; writers escape them as \x3E and \x40 in double-quoted YAML scalars, which read back as the same characters.
R11.notApplicable: R11 is a recommendation: a raw '>' or '@' in a FASTA header line makes a validator warn, not reject, so no input is invalid under it. The valid fhp-fasta-escaped-record-markers vector cites R11.

R12.summary: Header parsing: YAML metadata is read with YAML 1.2 core-schema types and must read the same under YAML 1.1; explicit tags and plain scalars that the two versions read differently (010, 1_000, 1:30, yes, on, 1e3) are invalid.
R12.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

R13.summary: Numbers: a numeric metadata value must be a finite number. YAML .nan, .inf and -.inf, and NaN or Infinity written as a JSON extension, make the record invalid.
R13.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

R14.summary: Links: a value whose schema format is uri should use http or https (ftp, urn, doi and info are also accepted); any other scheme, such as javascript:, data: or file:, stays schema-valid, but validators warn and JSON-LD writers do not write it as a link.
R14.notApplicable: R14 makes validators warn, not reject: an unexpected link scheme is schema-valid. This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

R15.summary: Extension fields: from FHR 2.1 and FHP and FHGFF3 1.1, a top-level key matching ^x-[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*$ may hold any value; every other unknown key, an x- key in a nested object and an x- key in a record that states the older minor or cites an older release stay invalid; R8, R11, R12 and R13 apply to them.

M1.summary: Microdata: exactly one FHR item scope; a nested item scope without itemprop is a separate item whose properties do not leak.
M1.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

M2.summary: Microdata: HTML parsing with implied end tags; values come from the defining element's value attribute, else its text.
M2.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

M3.summary: Microdata: data-fhr-type values must match the declared JSON type; typed strings are exact; untyped schema numbers and lists are converted.
M3.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

M4.summary: Microdata: the extracted metadata must validate against fhr.json; a repeated property cannot fill a single-valued field.
M4.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

J1.summary: JSON-LD: a canonical document has a published FHR context (embedded or a known URL) and no keyword but @type and a root @id; @context and @type are set aside, subjectOf is documentation, and export terms are set aside.
J1.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

J2.summary: JSON-LD: duplicate object keys are invalid.
J2.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

J3.summary: JSON-LD: any other form is read by JSON-LD 1.1 expansion with bundled contexts only. The only context allowed is the FHR context (a known URL or an embedded copy equal as parsed JSON, alone or as the only item of an array) on a top-level object; any other context, remote, unknown, embedded, extended or nested, is invalid.
J3.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

J4.summary: JSON-LD: exactly one top-level node (directly or the only item of @graph); every property must map to an FHR field in its scope, and unknown terms or a root @id make the document invalid.
J4.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

J5.summary: JSON-LD: IRI fields take @id or a string; dateCreated takes xsd:date or no type, and no other datatype is allowed; single-valued fields take one value; commandLineOption comes from @list; a node given only by @id is invalid.
J5.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

J6.summary: JSON-LD: the resulting metadata must validate against fhr.json.
J6.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

J7.summary: JSON-LD: writers emit the record with an embedded context and typed nodes, byte for byte as docs/JSONLD.md describes.
J7.notApplicable: J7 constrains writers; a reader has no invalid input for it. Its vectors are writer output in the family manifest (see its note).

J8.summary: JSON-LD in HTML: inside <script type="application/ld+json">, '<', '>' and '&' in the JSON text are written as \u003c, \u003e and \u0026; the document reads back to the same metadata.
J8.notApplicable: J8 constrains writers that embed JSON-LD in HTML; the escaped text is ordinary JSON, so a reader has no invalid input for it.

P1.summary: FHP: the metadata of a protein FASTA header must validate against fhp.json.

P2.summary: FHP: a record is read as FHP only when its schema is an FHP schema URL; any other header is validated as FHR.

G1.summary: FHGFF3: line 1 is ##gff-version 3; the leading header block runs from line 2 to the first nonblank line that is not a # line, or to ##FASTA; #~ lines may be mixed with other # lines inside it, and a #~ line on line 1 or after it is invalid.
G1.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

G2.summary: FHGFF3: the metadata must validate against fhgff3.json, including the genome link (an annotates link to an FHR genome, a genomeReference, or both).
G2.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

G3.summary: FHGFF3: a record is read as FHGFF3 only when its schema is an FHGFF3 schema URL; any other header is validated as that type.
G3.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

V1.summary: Selection: the raw-main URL of a type's schema file selects the current schema of that type; there is no fallback to an older release. Raw URLs under either repository name, FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification or FHR-Specification, are the same.
V1.notApplicable: The valid fhp-fasta-schema-canonical-raw-main vector cites V1; the rejection side is a schema-selection vector of the family manifest (see its note).

V2.summary: Selection: a release's raw tag URL (.../FAIR-bioHeaders-Specification/vX.Y.Z/<file>, or the same under FHR-Specification) selects that release's schema of the file's type.
V2.notApplicable: The valid fhp-fasta-schema-raw-tag vector cites V2; the rejection side is a schema-selection vector of the family manifest (see its note).

V3.summary: Selection: a w3id URL https://w3id.org/fair-bioheaders/<type>/vX.Y.Z (trailing slash allowed) selects that release's schema of the type, including older releases.
V3.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

V4.summary: Selection: a release that the reader does not have, a release without a schema of that type, or a raw URL with any other ref gives an unsupported-version result, never another schema.

V5.summary: Selection: any other schema value is FHR, validated against the current FHR schema.
V5.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.

V6.summary: Selection, FHR 1 compatibility: a record whose schema is the raw-main fhr.json URL (either repository name) and whose schemaVersion is the number 1 (1 or 1.0, not the string "1" or a boolean) is an FHR 1 record, validated against the v0.3.1 FHR schema; the citation is deprecated, not invalid.
V6.notApplicable: This rule's vectors belong to the complete family manifest, which runs from the pinned shared tree under .github/workflows/shared-parity.yml; the FHP-owned manifest stays scoped to the fhp-fasta set and the FASTA-container R-rule vectors.
